howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: This isn't Udemy. This isn't Coursera. You don't pick from someone else's catalog — you tell our AI what you want to learn, and it builds a path that exists nowhere else on Earth.
howItWorks.step1Title: Tell Us What You Want to Learn
howItWorks.step1Desc: Quantum physics, classical guitar, Korean cooking, game design — literally anything you can imagine. Just type it in.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Expert AI instructors generate a personalized, hands-on learning path crafted just for you. No cookie-cutter courses.
howItWorks.step3Desc: No passive videos. You build real things from day one — guided step by step by AI that adapts to your pace.
howItWorks.step4Title: Master Skills That Matter to You
howItWorks.step4Desc: Track your progress, crush milestones, and walk away with skills nobody else has — because this path was made for you.

examples.title: If You Can Dream It, You Can Learn It
examples.description: No pre-made catalog. No limits. Our AI generates a custom learning path for anything you can imagine — here are just a few ideas.
examples.aiDesc: Go from zero to deploying your own AI-powered applications. Build chatbots, image generators, and intelligent automation — no CS degree required.
examples.musicDesc: Learn flamenco guitar, jazz piano, electronic music production, or the theremin. Your AI instructor meets you at your level and pushes you further.
examples.astroDesc: Capture stunning images of nebulae and galaxies from your backyard. Learn telescope setup, long-exposure techniques, and deep-sky image processing.
examples.fermentDesc: Craft your own kombucha, sourdough, hot sauce, or home-brewed beer. Master the science of fermentation through hands-on experiments.
examples.screenDesc: Write your first short film, pilot episode, or feature screenplay. Learn story structure, dialogue, and world-building guided by AI.
examples.dreamDesc: Urban beekeeping, quantum computing, calligraphy, drone racing, leather crafting, ancient Greek — if you can think it, you can learn it.

testimonials.title: Loved by Learners
testimonials.description: Real stories from people who transformed their abilities.
testimonials.t1Quote: I always wanted to play guitar but classroom lessons never clicked. LearnAnything had me strumming songs within a week because every lesson involved actually playing.
testimonials.t2Quote: I went from zero coding knowledge to building my first web app in a month. The project-based approach made it feel like I was creating something real from day one.
testimonials.t3Quote: The step-by-step baking projects were amazing. I now make bakery-quality sourdough at home, and I actually understand the science behind every rise.
testimonials.t4Quote: I built my first bookshelf following a LearnAnything project. It's still standing! The hands-on approach gave me confidence to tackle bigger projects.
testimonials.t5Quote: I had no machine learning background, but LearnAnything walked me through building my own AI apps step by step. Within weeks I deployed a working chatbot and an image classifier — skills I now use at work every day.
testimonials.t6Quote: I used to think good coffee required expensive equipment, but LearnAnything taught me the science behind extraction, grind size, and water temperature. Now I brew pour-overs and espressos that rival my favorite café — my mornings have never been the same.

cta.headline1: The World's First Truly Personalized Learning Platform
cta.subtext1: No catalogs. No waiting lists. Just tell us what you want to learn and our AI does the rest.
cta.subtext2: Whatever you've always wanted to learn — this is the moment. Completely free, powered by AI, built for you.

valueProposition.title: Why LearnAnything?
valueProposition.description: The future of education isn't a library of pre-recorded videos. It's an AI that knows exactly what you need and builds it on the fly.
valueProposition.value1Desc: Every learning path is generated by advanced AI that understands your goals, your level, and how to get you there. It's like having a world-class tutor for every subject that exists.
valueProposition.value2Desc: Forget one-size-fits-all courses made for the masses. Your learning path is custom-built around your experience, your goals, and your pace. No two paths are the same.
valueProposition.value3Desc: There is no catalog to browse. There is no limit. From quantum computing to pottery, from hip-hop production to ancient Sumerian — if you can name it, we can teach it.
